comments.text:
All right, it's Wednesday at 11 PM, time for Re:Zero!
Incidentally, today is also the birthday of Sylphy Elmart (No. 184), who appeared in the season 3 anime! Sylphy is currently Emilia's most passionate supporter. How would she react if she learned what's happening in the main story now...? Anyway, happy birthday to her, and thanks again for joining this week!
Last time, Subaru's modern knowledge went wild and the great library was opened, and from there... wait, did the on-screen text just roll? Which means the OP is...
I was looking forward to seeing how the contents of the books here would be depicted too. They're even harder to read than I expected. Exciting.
If it's a notorious library in an RPG, then of course all sorts of things happen. Falling into a book is one of the classics.
In FF5, I liked that part where you fight on the open pages of a book.

What began alongside the sepia-toned scenery was Subaru's monologue...?
But the one who appeared was someone you all know.
A father conveying "If you do bad things, you'll be punished" in a slightly extreme way.

Here, I said it would be nice if dust rose up across the town at the end because of the wind, and as the author, I was surprised when dust rose up in a city bigger than I expected. That was Typhon, striding all over the place like that.
"Well, it was easy though!" "Y-yeah, it was easy though!"

As for the "Balroy Temeglyph" Julius read, it's covered in detail in the Re:Zero Ex volume "The Golden Lion and the Sword Saint." It's about Julius, Reinhard, and Ferris going to the Empire before the Royal Selection and ending up in serious trouble. It's good!
Wasn't the A-part way too fast!?
The truth is, after reaching the tower, Meili's role was over, so now she has nothing to do and is bored. She's honestly not very interested in conquering the tower.

Thanks to the effects of the "Divine Protection of Soul Language," Meili was basically a beast-version wolf girl. After that, her model for human-like behavior was Elsa, so this is a case of having the wrong textbook.

There are various ways to make use of this library, but none of them are intuitive, so it's pretty difficult. Well, the person who built this place made it by their own standards, so it has that kind of thing going on. Like, "If I can do it, other people should be able to as well," basically.
Subaru gets scolded by Emilia for taking promises too lightly.
When Emilia-tan heard "someone with a bad personality," who exactly did she picture as she found the stairs? Hint: it's the four-character "Witch of Greed" that starts with E and ends with na!
Strange, isn't it? Even though I'm seeing it for the first time, somehow I feel like I've seen this sword a thousand times before... ope, ning??
Shaula just showed up and now there's another new character!!
And then, unbelievably, double telops at the beginning and the very end! The OP and ED were sacrificed...!
Good job, Emilia-tan, for remembering properly.

That was fast! Seriously, this week's episode is over already!
Presented by Shaula foaming at the mouth and passing out! Between Shaula and "Stick Swinger," I couldn't help thinking the new characters are getting a lot of exposure. Well, it is a desert stage, so it can't be helped!
Now then, what can an appearing "Stick Swinger" even do against them! And with that "go get 'em, Julius," see you again next week! Thanks!

And from 30 minutes past the hour, it's mini anime time! Be sure to remember this flow every time!!!
This week is a Julius-focused story. It's his story from what happened at the end of Season 3 up to where he is now in Season 4.
